correctness.rationale: For n>=2 and fixed symmetric entrywise nonnegative doubly stochastic 0<W≼I with eigenvalue 1 simple, H positive diagonal, exact tracker initialization yields invariant codimension-one subspace sum(y-Hz)=0. Eliminating y yields the symmetric quadratic pencil Q_alpha(zeta)=(zeta I-W)W^-1(zeta I-W)+alpha(zeta-1)H. Permanent simple eigenvalue 1 has nonadmissible eigenvector (1,0). For zeta=e^{it} nonreal unit-circle, imaginary and real null-form equations imply z*Wz-z*W^-1 z-alpha z*Hz=0, impossible. Small positive alpha puts the second consensus branch 1-alpha mean(h)+O(alpha²) inside the disk; all other branches start at eigenvalues of W of modulus<1. The first crossing must be at -1 and Q_alpha(-1)=W^-1+2I+W-2alpha H gives exact positive-definiteness frontier. For larger alpha a negative min pencil eigenvalue at -1 and positive-leading coefficient as zeta→-∞ yield a real root <-1. The left eigenvector projection argument shows threshold/supercritical bad modes are excitable by some valid primal initialization; primal convergence would force tracker convergence, ruling out false failure. Exact independently reconstructed 2x2 example gives alpha*=9/5, det(C-18H/5)=0, and characteristic (z-1)(z+1)(40z²-12z-19)/40. No finite test is used as a universal proof.
residual_risks: The theorem excludes W with zero or negative eigenvalues, nonsymmetric time-varying networks, nonlinear objectives, and differing node steps.
Analytic proof does not give finite-precision numerical robustness or transient norm bounds.
Only exact two-agent certificate independently executed here; source-reported 168 random networks were inspected as code but not independently rerun.

value.rationale: The exact all-network common-step stability threshold for a motivated class of lazy SPD consensus mixing matrices and heterogeneous local curvatures replaces conservative fixed-network tuning by one computable symmetric generalized eigenvalue. The exclusion of nonreal unit-circle crossings supplies structural information about the sharp flip frontier, not merely a numerical bound. It is distinct from optimizing an asymptotic contraction rate or obtaining local online step selection, and arbitrarily many agents are included.
residual_risks: The exact threshold needs global W,H and is not a decentralized tuning rule.
It remains a sharp stability boundary, not the optimizer of convergence speed.

limitations: Literature search is best-of-knowledge and not an exhaustive priority certificate.
Primary 2019 paper uses a distinct x-update placement; exact algorithm equivalence requires proof, not assumed.
Independent finite randomized sweep was not rerun; exact certificate and analytic proof were independently checked.
